subject: Nathan APPROVED the C2 Modal smoke (~$2 GPU)
body: Relayed by nathan-c: Nathan explicitly approved the 5-sample Modal smoke for harness/modal_vllm.py with Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B (~$2 GPU). Follow the live-run rules: lock with the reason 'live run', post when you start and when you finish, and commit the smoke result. Done means Sample.reasoning is filled. Next, Nathan wants to run the E3a/E3b control conditions; once the smoke passes, please make sure the Modal target can serve a held-out sweep (warm container, batched calls) so GPU idle time stays low.
